ideas.title: Stuck in the sand: dig, plank, push, rock it free
ideas.goal: Sail too far into the soft dry sand and the wheels really dig themselves in: they sink, push up berms and stop. Then the player gets the yacht out like a person would: dig the sand away in front of the wheels (it slides back in if the hole is too steep), wedge a plank under a wheel, get the friends to push, or let a gust rock it out. Getting stuck and getting free is the play loop SnowRunner and MudRunner built whole games on: every stuck is a different puzzle, because the sand is where you left it.
ideas.toward: It is the big goal's own law (on planks the cart needs a twentieth of the push it needs in dry sand) turned into something the player solves with their own hands, and the friends pushing is its clip.
ideas.idea: The four wheels run in the GPU sand field (physics/sandfield.jl, which already keeps ruts, slumps to repose and rests planks by Bekker): each wheel's sinkage and resistance from the Wong-Reece wheel model (Bekker normal stress, Janosi-Hanamoto shear over the contact arc, slip sinkage), and what it displaces goes into ruts and berms in the field. The deeper it sinks the more the resistance grows, so a slow cart in soft sand buries itself and stops, by the numbers, not a stuck state. Lumi's beak removes sand cells (the walls slump back to the angle of repose, so you dig a ramp, not a hole); a plank is a body on the field that spreads the wheel's load; friends push with traction from the same shear law under their feet. Watching: wheels half buried, sand sprayed back, the ruts and the dig marks staying on the beach.
ideas.form: Coupling the yacht plugin's wheels to the sand field on the GPU, a dig action for Lumi, planks as items; played in Jump in, filmed as a stuck-and-free clip.

ideas.title: Two wheels up: friends hike out on the rail
ideas.goal: In a gust the yacht heels and the windward wheels lift off the sand; the player sends the pony friends out to the high rail one by one (keys 1-3) to hold it down, eases the sheet to save it, or goes over and the friends tumble into the sand. Riding on two wheels at the edge is the thrill of real land yachting.
ideas.toward: The road step 'Sail it yourself: sheet, tiller, friends leaning out' and friends aboard the cart; the friends become the cart's ballast, a job on the machine (todo #754).
ideas.idea: The cart becomes a rigid body with four wheel contacts on the terrain (PrintSim's affine body and contact, or its rigid solver), the sail's force applied at its centre of effort taken from the 3D box's pressure on the sail, and each friend a real mass at a place on the deck that the player moves. The heeling moment against the righting moment of the masses decides: one wheel lifts, the cart flies on two, or the moment wins and it rolls over, and the friends are ragdolls thrown by the same step. Lumi's body leans out with them.
ideas.form: Rigid-body yacht and friend ballast in the plugin; Jump in keys; the clip of a two-wheel run and a capsize.

ideas.title: The low-tide sea: a solved flood over a sailing flat
ideas.goal: Twice a game day the sea drains off a wide sand flat and the yacht can sail far; when the tide turns the water comes back up the creeks first, cuts off the far side of the flat, and a cart caught out sinks its wheels in sand that is soaked; the player reads the water and races it home.
ideas.toward: A place to sail (the island has no flat 20 m of beach, s168 scan) and the daily rhythm of the big goal.
ideas.idea: The sea around the island is a 2D shallow-water solver with wetting and drying on the GPU (a positivity-preserving finite-volume scheme on Mantle, or TrixiShallowWater), driven by a tide at its open edge over the island's real foreshore; the flood's front speed, the creeks and the puddles left in hollows come from the solver. Each sand cell keeps how long it was under water and dries by evaporation over time; its saturation sets Bekker's numbers for the wheels (damp = firm, soaked = soft). The water plane in the renderer is the solver's surface.
ideas.form: An engine water change and a foreshore in the terrain; the human's island gets tides.

ideas.title: The dynamo lamp: sail into the dusk and the mast lights up
ideas.goal: At dusk the player sails with a lamp on the mast that the axle's dynamo feeds: the faster the cart, the brighter it glows; luff and it dims to red; switch it on and the dynamo's drag slows the cart, so light costs speed. The pots on the deck charge from what is left.
ideas.toward: The road step 'a dynamo on its axle charges the pots' and the big goal's stored wind.
ideas.idea: A wound coil and magnets on the axle (physics/em.jl, motor.jl), EMF from the real flux change at the wheel's speed, the circuit solver (circuit.jl) carrying it into a hot-wire lamp whose temperature comes from Joule heat against radiation and whose glow is a Hikari blackbody light, and into the clay pots; the back-EMF torque is a real drag on the cart. Watching: a cart crossing the darkening beach with a lamp that brightens as it gathers speed.
ideas.form: Plugin parts on the yacht, a lamp light in the path tracer; a dusk film.
